title: Space Complexity
description: Understand how algorithms consume memory and learn how programmers analyze memory efficiency.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content:
Efficient algorithms must manage both execution time and memory usage.

Some algorithms execute quickly but consume large amounts of memory, while others use minimal memory but perform slower computations.

Space complexity helps programmers analyze how much memory an algorithm requires during execution.

sections.title: What is Space Complexity?
sections.content:
Space complexity measures how much memory an algorithm consumes as the input size grows.

This includes variables, arrays, temporary data structures, and function call memory.

Understanding memory consumption is important because computer systems have limited resources.

sections.title: Arrays and Memory Usage
sections.content:
Arrays consume memory based on the number of elements they store.

As arrays grow larger, they require more memory space.

Algorithms that create multiple large arrays may increase memory usage significantly during execution.

sections.title: Recursion and the Call Stack
sections.content:
Recursive algorithms use additional memory through the call stack.

Every function call stores information such as variables, parameters, and return locations.

Deep recursion can consume large amounts of memory and may eventually cause stack overflow problems if not managed carefully.

sections.title: Memory Usage Trade-offs
sections.content:
Programmers often balance speed and memory usage while designing algorithms.

Some solutions intentionally use more memory to achieve faster execution time.

Modern systems such as mobile applications, embedded systems, and large-scale servers constantly optimize memory efficiency to improve performance.

sections.title: Lesson Summary
sections.content: Space complexity describes how much memory an algorithm consumes during execution. Arrays, variables, recursion, and temporary data structures all contribute to memory usage. Understanding space complexity helps programmers design efficient and scalable systems.
